question: How many calibration drugs resolve the twelve previously frozen Bircsak calls at 90% and 80% nominal simultaneous coverage?
prediction_before_analysis: Quantile finite-size inflation may decrease but residual-tail floor may leave some or all calls unresolved even at n=200. All endpoints and methods retained.
evidence_status: post-reveal retrospective empirical-resampling extrapolation; not a new prospective test

cross_fitting.outer: Leave one drug out, fit on the other 20 drugs. Both endpoints share membership.
cross_fitting.inner: Within the 20 outer-training drugs, leave one drug out (19 fit drugs), select each endpoint by equal-drug mean MAE among the frozen 13 candidates; tie tolerance 1e-12 and original candidate order.
cross_fitting.training_designs: All combinations of three distinct concentrations as in existing model.
cross_fitting.evaluation_context: For L sorted distinct positive doses, use indices [0, floor((L-1)/3), floor(2*(L-1)/3)] per curve; each endpoint uses exactly three observed concentrations. Expose candidate dose metadata, conceal other responses.
cross_fitting.isolation: Outer-held-out responses never enter that fold selection, fitting, analog pools, epsilon or membership. Historic test drugs become retrospective cross-fit observations in other folds. Original 6/9/6 predictions and candidate selections remain frozen and unmodified.
cross_fitting.fit_reuse: Identical training subsets and effective leaf sizes reuse predictions. A pair of excluded drugs shares one fitted model; both are predicted. No approximation to original estimator.

score: For each drug and method, maximum absolute query residual across both endpoints divided by endpoint max(abs(lowest-context response), 1e-6*median(abs(outer-training endpoint responses)), 1e-12).

resampling.rule: k=ceil((n+1)*coverage), integer arithmetic; q=kth smallest in n iid draws with replacement from 21 scores; k>n means +infinity.
resampling.distribution: Exact empirical bootstrap order-statistic distribution via binomial survival P(q<=s_j)=P[Binomial(n,j/21)>=k]; no Monte Carlo approximation.
resampling.quantile_definition: left-continuous inverse empirical CDF (smallest value with cumulative probability at least target)
resampling.extrapolation: n>21 is extrapolation from the same 21 drugs; repeated draws are not additional independent evidence. Bands quantify calibration-sample variability conditional on this empirical distribution, not population-distribution uncertainty.
resampling.asymptotic: Report empirical population coverage quantiles as n tends to infinity; prediction residual floor does not shrink as 1/sqrt(n).

widths.endpoint_halfwidth: q * mean lowest-context scale over six original test drugs for endpoint

anchor.procedure: Recompute original nine selected scores and q=max from original calibration predictions; frozen full widths must match to rounding. Cross-fit n=9 is a different distribution and is not forced to equal anchor.

decisions.prediction_centers: Original frozen six-test-drug predictions for all three methods; use only original three observations, predicted means, concentrations and scale.
decisions.rule: Per endpoint flag a 50% response reduction relative to its lowest observed dose. If an observed context value or any upper prediction bound is <= 0.5*lowest response, output report_reduction. If all observed contexts and all lower bounds are > threshold, output report_no_reduction. Otherwise output measure_next. If lowest context <=0, output measure_next and preserve the curve in MAE analysis. This is a research threshold, separate from validated clinical toxicity classification.
decisions.counts: ALBUMIN six, VIABILITY six, joint twelve. At least one >=1, strict majority >=4 of6 (>=7 of12), all >=6 (>=12).
decisions.threshold_reporting: Minimum n with bootstrap probability of achieving target >=0.5; also >=0.8 and sustained threshold through n=200. Report unavailable thresholds as not attained within 5..200. Quantile sawtooth is retained.
decisions.revealed_outcomes: Used only in cross-fit residual computation and post-hoc call correctness audit, never to alter original frozen centers or thresholds; prospective validity is not asserted.

resources.large_fit_route: private Kaggle CPU notebook, no GPU
resources.termination: finite prescribed leave-one-out fits and n=5..200 grid; all launched local processes terminate; remote notebook auto-terminates at complete/error

limitations: Overlapping cross-fit training sets induce dependence; simple score bootstrap is a planning heuristic, not a coverage guarantee.

Cross-fit models use 20 training drugs, while original frozen test centers used six; changes in both training support and calibration sampling separate this curve from a causal calibration-size experiment.
Digitized published mean responses, no new donor/batch/chip replicates.
Original test responses were revealed before this protocol.
